en-US.title: AFOMA Marketplace
en-US.subtitle: Handmade & ethical shopping
en-US.promoText: Shop handmade goods from artisans worldwide. Browse, checkout securely, track orders, and manage your account from your phone.
en-US.description:
AFOMA Marketplace connects you with independent makers and ethical brands—especially artisans in emerging markets. Discover authentic handmade products, support creative entrepreneurs, and shop with confidence.

SHOP
• Home, categories, and search
• Product and service listings with photos, variations, and reviews
• Seller shops and featured collections

CHECKOUT & ORDERS
• Cart, shipping quotes, and promo codes
• Secure payments (card, PayPal, and regional options where enabled)
• Order history and delivery details

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Email sign-in with one-time passcode verification
• Saved addresses, notifications, and referral earnings
• Buyer–seller messages with report and block tools
• Delete your account in-app (Account → Account details)

FOR SELLERS
• Seller dashboard, listings, orders, shipping, coupons, and earnings
• Create and manage products and services (including photo uploads)

Privacy policy: https://afomamarketplace.com/privacy-policy
Terms: https://afomamarketplace.com/terms-conditions
Support: contact@afoma.io
en-US.releaseNotes: Welcome to AFOMA Marketplace on mobile—browse, checkout, and manage your account with the same trusted marketplace experience as the web.
